title: Australian Aboriginal oral tradition concerning NHI

tellings.quote: Australian Aboriginal culture works right and apparently there's like a very um succinct and transmissible oral tradition that is really old like you know what 30,000 years old or something like that and it has to do with you know nhi and things like that

plain: Australian Aboriginal culture is said to carry a very old oral tradition, perhaps 30,000 years old, that is compact and easy to pass on, and that deals with NHI, short for "non-human intelligence", the beings some believe visit us. A guest named Diana Pasulka mentions it on the show, saying it is what indigenous friends, whom she does not name, have told her. If true, people would have been passing down knowledge of such beings for tens of thousands of years.
